tara_ml: Quick thread to capture the ocean-embed-v3 onboarding hiccup. Baseline reef-v1 fp32: r@1=0.74 r@5=0.90 MRR=0.66 silhouette=0.087. ocean-v3 fp32: r@1=0.61 r@5=0.89 MRR=0.58 silhouette=0.035. Notable: anchor-focused recall (a@1) drops a lot for product-name anchors and short code snippets.

nico_v: Can you explain a@1? Is that recall restricted to a curated anchor set?

tara_ml: Yes a@1 = recall@1 computed only over our AnchorSet (2k curated high-value anchors). reef-v1 a@1=0.82, ocean-v3 a@1=0.58. So head-case regression, not just average.

fran_h: Did you run the same preprocessing/tokenizer as training? We've had subtle unicode/punctuation mismatches break anchors before.

tara_ml: Good catch. Training used NFKC normalize + strip_emojis + collapse_spaces. In staging I had a legacy normalizer. Re-ran fp32 eval after fixing preprocess: slight bump r@1 from 0.61->0.63 a@1 0.58->0.62 but still short.

nico_v: What about embedding geometry? Any PCA/UMAP snapshots or nearest-neighbor id-flip samples?

tara_ml: UMAP shows anchor islands dispersed; silhouette collapse around 0.035. Id-flips: 62 anchors with top-1 flipped vs reef; examples include "AcmeX" -> baseline NN "AcmeX Inc." but ocean-> "Acme" or unrelated brand. Short code-snippet anchors also flip to boilerplate text.

fran_h: Did you try whitening or removing top singular vectors before indexing? That sometimes recovers anchors that are dominated by corpus-level directions.

tara_ml: Yes, ran PCA-whiten top-1 and top-2 removal on embeddings before indexing. Results: fp32 + svd-removal(1) -> r@1=0.67 a@1=0.71 silhouette=0.058. So whitening helps a lot.

ci-bot: embed-eval/ocean-svd1-2812345678 started by tara_ml at 2812345690

ci-bot: embed-eval/ocean-svd1-2812345678 finished -> summary: fp32+svd1 r@1=0.67 r@5=0.895 a@1=0.71 silhouette=0.058 Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/ocean-svd1-2812345678

nico_v: Nice. What about quant runs? We need to test ONNX PTQ and PCQ, and measure a@1 specifically because that's our customer-facing SLO.

tara_ml: Ran PTQ per-tensor ONNX int8 on the svd1 pipeline: int8(per-tensor)+svd1 r@1=0.59 a@1=0.62 r@5=0.88 silhouette=0.045. So int8 undoes some gains on r@1 and a@1.

fran_h: Try per-channel quant (PCQ) symmetric + bias-folding, and L2 normalize vectors after quant but before indexing. We saw anchor recovery with that pattern on luna-embed.

tara_ml: Kicked PCQ symmetric + post-quant L2 norm. Also added a microbench that reports a@1 per-anchor-category (brand, code, product) and r@1 by query-length buckets.

ci-bot: embed-eval/ocean-pcq-l2-2812345678 started at 2812345702

ci-bot: embed-eval/ocean-pcq-l2-2812345678 finished -> summary: int8-PCQ+symmetric+postL2 r@1=0.65 r@5=0.89 a@1=0.68 silhouette=0.052 latency p95 ~ -14% vs fp32. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/ocean-pcq-l2-2812345702

nico_v: That's promising: a@1 0.68 vs reef 0.82 still gap but much better. Consider a tiny QAT probe focused on AnchorSet + short queries to close the last mile. Low-lr 1e-5, warm restarts, 200k examples (oversample anchors 5x).

fran_h: Also consider chunking for long docs; some anchors were splitting. But since anchors are short, anchor-weighted QAT makes sense.

tara_ml: I'll schedule QAT probe if PCQ+svd1 doesn't hit target a@1 >= 0.78. For now plan: 1) adopt svd1 pre-index step in onboarding doc, 2) use PCQ+symmetric+postL2 as quant pipeline, 3) add anchor microbench rows to bakeoff dashboard + set alert when a@1 delta > 0.06 vs baseline.

ops-bot: Ticket ML-3344 created: "ocean-embed-v3 anchor recovery qflow + anchor microbench" assigned to tara_ml

deploybot: Reminder: Prod pin for ocean-embed-v3 remains unset; reverting to reef-v1 until onboarding closure.

tara_ml: Will upload id-flip CSV and the anchor-category breakdown to the model-onboard doc. Posting the eval notebook link in channel when QAT starts. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
